description: iNaturalist link to last sample recorded pre-1990 OR the sample we are re-sampling off of, if it is not the most recent one

variables: T - findable along a trail, but can't pinpoint to an exact location
I - recent record on iNat likely confirming location where otherwise uncertain
S - general search area probably findable
R - remove from list due to being seen more recently
O - remove from list due to being outside of Royal
C - sample gone, remove from list
L - in hindsight, location maybe not accurate enough
I - location was incorrect or did not match description
R - could return to search more within the area or different area in hindsight
T - possibly found it but not enough fertile material for ID
F - maybe missed because not flowering/visible
C - used more recent iNat observations to find location
